  },

    {
      "id": "overlay_stars_top_left",
      "kind": "overlay",
      "bbox": [
        58,
        32,
        170,
        120

    },
    {
      "id": "photo_top_left",
      "kind": "photo",
      "bbox": [
        106,
        74,
        560,
        305

    },
    {

        585,
        115,
        990,
        270

      "text": "When we arrived at the\nsouthernmost tip of the\nAfrican continent, Cape Town\nwas right in front of us\nan unforgettable journey.",

      "font": "hand",
      "align": "left",
      "bold": false,
      "italic": false
    },
    {
      "id": "overlay_doodle_sparkle",

        425,
        150,
        550,

    },
    {
      "id": "overlay_doodle_star_path",

        145,

      "id": "photo_center",
      "kind": "photo",
      "bbox": [

        765,
        600

    },
    {
      "id": "overlay_doodle_fish",
      "kind": "overlay",

        780,

      "id": "overlay_island_sticker",

    },
    {

      "kind": "overlay",
      "bbox": [
        105,
        760,
        390,
        865

    {
      "id": "overlay_logo_watermark",
